name: Plesk
summary: Manage Plesk through vault-backed REST API v2 URI processes.
description: The connector exchanges a vault-held Plesk administrator login for a REST API key, immediately stores the generated key in the vault, and uses X-API-Key for later autonomous operations. Credentials are never accepted in URI payloads or returned in results.
useCases: Bootstrap a Plesk REST API key without exposing administrator credentials.
Read domains, clients, subscriptions, and other Plesk API resources.
Execute authorized Plesk API changes through auditable URI processes.

examples.title: Create and store a Plesk API key
